AssemblyView.description: One assembly in the read model.

children.description: Child ids (parts or assemblies) as stored.

parent.description: First assembly (document order) listing this assembly as a child.

Axis.description: A world/local coordinate axis, serialized as `"x"`, `"y"`, `"z"`.

AxisDir.description:
A signed axis direction, serialized as `"+x"`, `"-x"`, … `"-z"` (spec §1.1).

Declaration order (`+x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z`) is the canonical order used by §5.4.

inner_diameter.description: Inner (bore) diameter, must be smaller than `outer_diameter`.

vertical_height.description: Height of the upright above the base plate.

Binding.description: `{target, expr}` (§4.2). The bound field keeps its cached numeric value.

expr.description: Expression text, 1–160 chars (closed grammar §4.3, parsed by [`crate::expr`]).

oneOf.description: Intersect with a Volume or `envelope` Empty.

revision.description: Incremented by the coordinator on every accepted patch.

root.description:
Root part or assembly, maintained by the coordinator (§6.3). `null` while the document
has no parts yet (mid-loop revisions); required for completed documents.

Component.description: Wire form of [`Component`] used for deserialization and JSON Schema.

ComponentView.description: One component in the read model.

fields.description: Numeric shape fields (§3.3) in spec order with current values and binding state.

frame_port.description: Frame port name of an independent component (`null` for derived ones).

part.description: First part (document order) whose `body` references this component, if any.

ports.description:
Ports (§3.4) in table order; Empty `of` uses its source Volume's table (empty when the
source does not resolve).

refs.description: Ids referenced from `shape` (promotion sources), in field order.

Constraint.description: A constraint (§5.1): `{id, kind, a, b, value, u, v, frame}`.

oneOf.description: point–face or face–face signed distance along `n_b`.

ConstraintView.description: One constraint in the read model.

fields.description: Numeric fields of this kind (`value`, or `u`/`v`) with §5.1 defaults applied.

CoreResult.description: Op-specific result, tagged by `op` (the request's op name).

document.description: The canonical 2.0 document that was validated (the upgraded one for 1.0 input).

report.description: Analytic validation report (all issues, including the solver's).

resolved.description: Solver output (empty when the solver was gated, see `validate` module docs).

document.description:
The canonical 2.0 document with bindings and `root` recomputed. Bindings with errors
keep their cached value. If the recomputed document violates the schema, the response
is a `schema_violation` error instead.

issues.description: Binding issues of the recomputation (empty when all bindings evaluated).

expressible.description: Whether the document is expressible as CadDocument 1.0 (spec §10.2).

computed_root.description:
The root the coordinator would compute (spec §6.3); `null` when it would be
`invalid_root`.

input_version.description: `schema_version` of the input document (1.0 input is described after upgrading).

tree.description:
Assembly tree: top-level nodes (assemblies that are no assembly's child, then parts
that are no assembly's child), each with its children expanded recursively. Every
part / assembly is expanded at its first occurrence (pre-order) only; later
occurrences are [`TreeNode::repeated`] leaves, so the tree has at most
`assemblies + parts + Σ children` nodes (never more than [`MAX_TREE_NODES`]).

EdgeSelector.description: Edge selector for fillets and chamfers; default `vertical`.

EmptyRole.description: Empty `role` (§3.1), required on and exclusive to `kind = "empty"`.

oneOf.description: Bounding envelope; may be `intersect`ed by several parts.
An undo of an earlier accepted patch.

ErrorCode.description: Closed set of request-level error codes.

oneOf.description:
The request is not valid JSON, has an unknown `op`, an unknown / missing field or a
field of the wrong type (including an unknown `origin`), or is not UTF-8.
`document.schema_version` is missing, not a string, or not `"1.0"` / `"2.0"`.

A supported `schema_version` that this op does not accept (`upgrade` needs 1.0,
`downgrade` and `apply_patch` need 2.0).

The document does not deserialize into the typed model (not an object, wrong type,
unknown field, malformed id or reference, missing required field, …).

The document parsed but violates schema-level constraints (ranges, lengths, list caps,
cross-field shape rules); `violations` lists them all, `path` is the first.
The patch does not deserialize into the typed `Patch` model.

The response would exceed [`MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES`] and was discarded. Not expected for
documents within the schema limits (a safety net against output amplification).

An internal failure (a caught panic, or a broken internal size invariant such as
[`MAX_TREE_NODES`]). Never expected; please report.

name.description: Field name (`length`, `value`, `u`, …); `id:name` is its field reference.

value.description: Current (cached) value; `null` for an optional field that is null (not bindable).

Frame.description: Wire form of [`Frame`] (also its JSON Schema).

Layer.description: Which validation layer produced an issue (§9.1, §9.4).

oneOf.description: Geometry-kernel validation in the renderer sidecar.

through.description: A Dot the arc passes through.

base_revision.description:
Document revision when the entry was made (for patches: the revision the patch was
checked against, which differs from `patch.base_revision` exactly when it was
rejected as `stale_revision`).

doc_sha256_after.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document after the entry (`null` when rejected).

doc_sha256_before.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document before the entry.

issues.description:
Issues of the outcome: the full validation report when accepted, the attached P-class
issues when rejected.

patch.description:
The patch as submitted (`null` for undo entries).

Its JSON Schema is a plain object: a patch rejected as `schema_invalid` is logged as
submitted and need not satisfy `patch.schema.json`'s range / length constraints.

patch_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical patch JSON (`null` for undo entries).

revert.description: Reverse delta of an accepted patch (what undo applies); `null` otherwise.

revision_after.description: Revision after the entry; `null` when rejected.

schema_version.description: Document schema version the entry was produced under (`"2.0"`).

timestamp.description: Caller-supplied timestamp (the library never reads a clock).

undoes.description: For undo entries: `seq` of the undone patch entry.

Parameter.description: A named parameter (§4.1). `name` is in namespace N3 and may not be `min` / `max`.

min.description: Optional lower bound (`parameter_out_of_range` is a validator code).

body.description: Boolean recipe, 1–128 ops, first must be `add`.

PartView.description: One part in the read model.

parent.description: First assembly (document order) listing this part as a child.

PatchOrigin.description: Who submitted a patch: an agent role or `human`.

oneOf.description: The patch was accepted; the host replaces its document with `document`.

created.description: Components created by this patch, in document order.

doc_sha256_before.description: SHA-256 of the canonical input document.

log_entry.description:
The op-log entry to append (`seq` = request `log_seq`, `timestamp` = request
`timestamp`; contains the reverse delta for undo).

log_line.description: `log_entry` as the exact `oplog.jsonl` line (compact JSON, no trailing newline).

patch_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical patch JSON.

report.description: Validation of `document` (`completed = false`); only D-class issues.

oneOf.description: The patch was rejected; the host keeps its document unchanged.

doc_sha256_before.description: SHA-256 of the canonical input document (unchanged).

issues.description: The P-class issues behind a validation rejection (empty for other reasons).

log_entry.description: The op-log entry to append (rejections are logged too).

log_line.description: `log_entry` as the exact `oplog.jsonl` line (compact JSON, no trailing newline).

patch_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical patch JSON.

inners.description: Inner closed Lines (holes in the profile), ≤ 16.

offset.description: Local Z of the horizontal section (`Coord`).

name.description: Port name; `id.name` is its port reference.

patch_id.description: `r<revision_after>` of the creating patch; `null` for `migration`. ≤ 64 chars.

oneOf.description: A human edit (stamped by the coordinator).

ReasonCode.description: Patch reject reason (§9.2 last paragraph): a reject code or a P-class issue code.

RejectReason.description: Structured reject diagnostics returned to the submitter and written to the op log.

message.description:
Fixed-template message (ids, numbers and template text only; never free text such as
labels, notes or assumptions — §9.1).

op_index.description: Index of the offending op, when one op is to blame.

holes.description: Hole cut directions and main-hole cutter spans (§7).

ports.description: Ports referenced by constraints plus every component's frame port.

defaulted_axes.description: Axes defaulted to 0 by the under-constrained rule (§5.5 step 4), in axis order.

origin.description: World translation `t` (the frame port's world position for independent components).

ResolvedPort.description: A port's world geometry, discriminated by `type` (§3.4).

Revert.description: Previous values of the top-level keys a patch changed.

sections.description:
Top-level key → value before the patch (raw JSON: each value is the previous
canonical value of that top-level CadDocument 2.0 key).

Role.description: Agent roles (§8.1, §8.3). Used as issue `owner` and as the patch `agent`.

oneOf.description: Component smith: Dots, Lines, Planes, Volumes, `cut` Empties.

SchemaViolation.description: One schema-level violation (range, length, list cap, cross-field shape rule, …).

message.description: Human-readable, fixed-template message (embeds only ids and numbers).

path.description: JSON pointer to the offending value (`""` for the document root).

oneOf.description: Blocks rendering (and, for P-class codes, the patch).

ShapeName.description: `shape.kind` of a component (the name; pair with the component `kind`).

ShapeRef.description: A reference from a shape to another component.

TreeNode.description: A node of the assembly tree.

children.description:
Children (an assembly's first occurrence only; empty for parts, `missing` and
repeated nodes).

repeated.description:
`true` when this part / assembly already occurs earlier in the tree (pre-order): the
node is a back-reference to that first occurrence and has no children. Only documents
whose assembly graph is not a tree have repeated nodes: a child listed twice in one
assembly, a child of two assemblies (`multi_owner`) or a cycle (`reference_cycle`).
Always `false` for `missing` nodes.

TreeNodeKind.description: What a tree node refers to.

oneOf.description: A child id that is neither (dangling reference).

code.description: Issue code (see [`codes::Code`]); kept as a string so 1.0/kernel reports round-trip.

message.description: Fixed-template message; may embed only ids, numbers and template text (§9.1).

owner.description: Role that should fix the issue.

target.description: Component/constraint/part id or `id:field` the issue is about.

ValidationReport.description: `{valid, review_required, issues}` (same shape and rules as 1.0).

review_required.description: Planner flag, or any assumption, or any `error`/`warning`.

inner_diameter.description: Inner (bore) diameter, must be smaller than `outer_diameter`.

vertical_height.description: Height of the upright above the base plate.

oneOf.description: The request was processed; `result.op` equals the request `op`.
The request could not be processed at all.

path.description:
JSON pointer into the request (`/document`, `/document/components/3/shape/diameter`,
`/patch`, …); `null` when the error is not about one location.

violations.description:
All schema violations (`schema_violation` only; empty otherwise), with request-relative
paths.
